headline: Otter Tail (OTTR) Tops Q2 Earnings Estimates
summary: Otter Tail (OTTR) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +12.16% and -0.04%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
